purpose: Maxey0-OKF — the Open Knowledge Format v0.1 edition of the Maxey0 system. skill-selection index — load once per session, score tags against task, load ranked docs on demand

skills.title: Multi-Tier Memory Management
skills.description: Classifies, stores, summarizes, and promotes memory items across the five tiers through typed API contracts with evidence-gated promotion.

skills.title: Episodic Memory Engineering
skills.description: Engineers the episodic tier: turn chains, session summaries, handoff state, and drift snapshots — all resumable, time-stamped, and summarized at session close.

skills.title: Working Memory Management
skills.description: Manages the working (scratchpad) tier: volatile in-flight state, TTL enforcement, and guaranteed purge at session close.

skills.title: Semantic Memory Engineering
skills.description: Engineers the semantic tier — the OKF bundle itself: concept extraction, graph construction, alias normalization, and the promotion gate that admits items from episodic.

skills.title: Persistent Memory Management
skills.description: Manages the persistent tier: durable agent facts, versioned preferences, long-term observations — written rarely, always with a promotion evidence chain.

skills.title: Memory Promotion Policy Engineering
skills.description: Designs and enforces the gates that move items between tiers: relevance, evidence, consistency, reuse, and policy checks — with quarantine and repair paths for failures.

skills.title: Hierarchical Agent Orchestration
skills.description: Decomposes tasks into DAG-shaped unit plans and routes each unit to a primary+checker specialist pair under budget and policy constraints.

skills.title: Agent Registry Management
skills.description: Manages the 777-agent registry: hydration, search, role-based filtering, and the serving layer that skill-selection queries hit.

skills.title: Swarm Intelligence
skills.description: Coordinates agent swarms for embarrassingly parallel tasks: spawn, collect, reconcile — with convergence gates and contradiction resolution.

skills.title: Agent-to-Agent Protocol Engineering
skills.description: Defines, validates, versions, and adapts schema-checked A2A envelopes so any conformant agent can exchange work with the network.

skills.title: Model Context Protocol Engineering
skills.description: Builds and operates MCP servers: tool registration, capability advertisement, auth, and the lazy-load manifest pattern.

skills.title: Multi-MCP Federation
skills.description: Federates multiple MCP servers behind a unified discovery surface; routes tool calls to the right server without exposing federation internals to callers.

skills.title: Protocol Translation
skills.description: Translates between A2A, MCP, and foreign agent frameworks' message shapes without loss of contract fields.

skills.title: AI Observability
skills.description: Instruments every boundary with spans under the a2a.* and maxey0.okf.* namespaces, assembles replayable trace trees, and diagnoses from them.

skills.title: Agent Trace Analysis
skills.description: Consumes trace trees and produces causal diagnoses: failing paths, root causes, and minimal reproductions.

skills.title: Memory Access Telemetry
skills.description: Instruments tier reads and writes: access patterns, promotion events, and tier-crossing latencies — the data that makes memory policy auditable.

skills.title: Context Utilization Analytics
skills.description: Measures what entered a context window and how much of it was actually used: utilization ratios, dead-weight identification, and packing efficiency signals.

skills.title: Agent Evaluation
skills.description: Mirrors runs read-only to produce evidence-chained EvalReports and frame-labeled DriftSignals across reference frames A, B, and D.

skills.title: Swarm Evaluation
skills.description: Evaluates swarm outputs: coverage, contradiction rate, and convergence quality across the collected set.

skills.title: Enterprise Constitution Evaluation
skills.description: Evaluates whether deployed agents conform to their declared constitutional constraints — live compliance scoring, not just design-time analysis.

skills.title: Retrieval Attribution Evaluation
skills.description: Scores retrieval quality by tracing outputs back to their sources: did the system surface the right items, were they actually used, were attributions correct?

skills.title: Constitutional Constraint Enforcement
skills.description: Gates every proposed action against a versioned policy registry with cited allow/deny verdicts and audited enforcement.

skills.title: Enterprise Agent Governance
skills.description: Governs agent deployments at organizational scale: approval workflows, audit logs, policy versioning, and rollback.

skills.title: Enterprise Constitution Modeling
skills.description: Authors and versions the policy documents that enforcement gates read: law definitions, scope declarations, exception protocols.

skills.title: Cross-Organization Policy Negotiation
skills.description: Negotiates compatible policy scopes between organizations sharing agents or data: intersection finding, conflict resolution, escalation.

skills.title: Enterprise Memory Isolation
skills.description: Enforces memory isolation between organizational tenants: scope separation, access controls, and audit of cross-tenant operations.

skills.title: Latent Triangulation
skills.description: Estimates latent position and movement from anchor-relative distances over matched pre/post snapshots — disclosed-approximation (full-stream and subspace projection); causally validated, method-honesty labeled.

skills.title: Latent Space Engineering
skills.description: Builds and maintains the embedding-space substrate: vector stores, snapshot capture with metadata, cross-modal alignment — that all latent measurement skills depend on.

skills.title: Latent Space Mapping
skills.description: Produces navigable maps of latent regions via projection methods (PCA/SVD, UMAP) with distortion budgets declared per map and disclosed-approximation annotation.

skills.title: Latent Topology Analysis
skills.description: Characterizes latent region shape — neighborhoods, manifold structure, connectivity — from geometry-preserving graph constructions rather than raw projections.

skills.title: Magnitude Spectrum Analysis
skills.description: Analyzes magnitude distributions across latent dimensions under the superposition/polysemanticity discipline: variance ≠ causal weight, controls mandatory.

skills.title: Sparse Autoencoder Interpretability
skills.description: Trains and curates SAE feature dictionaries with the workspace caveat built in: SAE decoder directions are not automatically report-available.

skills.title: Latent Feature Attribution
skills.description: Attributes model behavior to latent features with causal grading: interventional evidence outranks correlational saliency; every attribution declares its evidence grade.

skills.title: Latent World Construction
skills.description: Constructs bounded scenario representations in latent terms with declared assumptions, tracked divergence, and disclosed-approximation state.

skills.title: Knowledge Graph Engineering
skills.description: Maintains the OKF-serialized graph through diffable document edits, integrity verification, alias normalization, and structure-informed routing.

skills.title: Property Graph Memory Engineering
skills.description: Engineers property graph representations for agent memory: node schemas, edge semantics, and traversal patterns.

skills.title: Graph Memory Construction
skills.description: Constructs graph memories from raw agent outputs: entity extraction, relationship inference, and deduplication.

skills.title: Graph Neural Network Routing
skills.description: Routes agent selection and skill matching using GNN features over the knowledge graph: neighborhood density, hub centrality, path distance.

skills.title: Temporal Knowledge Graph Management
skills.description: Manages time-stamped knowledge graph evolution: versioned edges, temporal queries, and change-event propagation.

skills.title: Memory Graph Evolution
skills.description: Engineers how the knowledge graph grows and prunes over time: addition protocols, deprecation, and garbage collection.

skills.title: Hybrid Vector-Graph Memory
skills.description: Combines vector search (fast approximate retrieval) with graph traversal (exact relational queries) into a unified memory access layer.

skills.title: Research Paper Integration
skills.description: Integrates a new research paper into the bundle: extract concepts, derive skills, map registry agents or propose new ones, enumerate operational topics, and materialize an application — the pipeline that produced this skill's examples/.

skills.title: Superposition Observation
skills.description: Maxey00's standing mirror: read-only shadow observation of every run, annotating quality, latency, cost, and drift without touching the observed workflow.

skills.title: Same-Tick Arbitration
skills.description: Receives outputs from two or more agents on the exact same logical tick and evaluates them against one shared state to test which output does X according to Y — real-time execution races, live integration checks, A/B at identical state.

skills.title: Actor-Critic Parallelism
skills.description: Runs propose/critique agent pairs and symmetric mirror-mode parallels under an arbiter: one agent proposes, one critiques, promotion only through reconciliation.

skills.title: Shared-State Synchronization
skills.description: Engineers the tick discipline that makes agentic superposition real: parallel and multithreaded GPU execution such that compute ticks are shorter than latent state transitions, with barriers, warp-style consensus votes, and atomic promotion.

skills.title: Superposition Coordinate Mapping
skills.description: Logs, maps, and learns superposition coordinates from latent state transitions using state-vector-machine models, so simultaneous states become a navigable, learnable record.

skills.title: Reasoning Frame Engineering
skills.description: Binds reasoning passes to versioned frames with mined anchors and rationale-complete context packages, recursing under discipline.

skills.title: Cognitive Architecture Engineering
skills.description: Designs the overall cognitive layout of an agent: which reasoning passes run in sequence, which in parallel, and how results compose.

skills.title: Cognitive Anchor Extraction
skills.description: Mines stable reference points from behavioral evidence: the anchors that reasoning frames are built around.

skills.title: Anchor-Based Reasoning
skills.description: Executes reasoning passes anchored to declared reference points; conclusions carry the anchor set that produced them.

skills.title: Recursive Self-Reflection
skills.description: Implements bounded self-reflection loops: depth-limited, summary-gated, stopping when marginal value falls below epsilon.

skills.title: World-Based Reasoning
skills.description: Reasons inside a declared world model: assumptions explicit, conclusions scoped to the world, divergence from base world tracked.

skills.title: Multi-World Reasoning
skills.description: Runs parallel reasoning passes in multiple worlds; compares and reconciles conclusions across worlds.

skills.title: Meta-Reasoning
skills.description: Reasons about reasoning: selects frames, evaluates which anchor sets are appropriate, and decides when to recurse or stop.

skills.title: Claim Lineage Analysis
skills.description: Records signed generation-time provenance, classifies every claim by its support, and answers lineage queries end to end.

skills.title: Hallucination Localization
skills.description: Localizes hallucinations to specific spans: which part of the output is unsupported, at what evidence level.

skills.title: Hallucination Attribution
skills.description: Attributes hallucinations to their cause: retrieval failure, inference error, context gap, or compression loss.

skills.title: Reasoning Path Instrumentation
skills.description: Instruments the reasoning path: which steps led to which claims, so reasoning audits are replayable.

skills.title: Agent Runtime Engineering
skills.description: Executes agent code inside enforced resource and isolation contracts, priced by risk budget, with purge-on-completion state discipline.

skills.title: Agent Infrastructure Engineering
skills.description: Designs and provisions the infrastructure layer for agent deployments: compute, networking, secret management, and health monitoring.

skills.title: Agent Platform Engineering
skills.description: Builds the platform abstractions agents run on: scheduling, load balancing, autoscaling, and the observability integrations the platform provides.

skills.title: Multi-Tenant Agent Infrastructure
skills.description: Provisions and isolates agent infrastructure across tenants: resource quotas, network separation, and tenant-scoped secret stores.

skills.title: Distributed Agent Runtime Engineering
skills.description: Operates agent runtimes across distributed compute: work distribution, fault tolerance, state coherence, and split-brain prevention.

skills.title: Tool Schema Negotiation
skills.description: Publishes owned, versioned service contracts; discovers and negotiates capabilities before first call; tests contracts in both directions.

skills.title: Tool Capability Discovery
skills.description: Discovers what tools and capabilities are available in the current environment: MCP servers, APIs, and local capabilities.

skills.title: Context Infrastructure Engineering
skills.description: Engineers the infrastructure that serves context to agents: retrieval endpoints, caching layers, and contract-validated context APIs.

skills.title: Inference Pipeline Engineering
skills.description: Engineers the pipeline from request to model inference: batching, routing, caching, and contract-validated responses.

skills.title: AI Platform Engineering
skills.description: Engineers the end-to-end AI platform: model serving, tool integration, agent orchestration endpoints, and platform-level observability.

skills.title: Structured Context World Engineering
skills.description: Designs and builds SCWs: schema-governed context packages with declared sections, budgets, and inclusion rationale. Primary mechanism for 75-85% per-turn token cost reduction by loading only task-relevant agents and knowledge.

skills.title: Context Packing Optimization
skills.description: Optimizes what enters a context window against token budgets: selection, compression, ordering — every exclusion justified, every compression lossless for contract fields.

skills.title: Context Lineage Tracking
skills.description: Tracks where every context element came from: source, transformation chain, inclusion rationale — so any packed context can answer provenance queries element by element.

skills.title: Context Persistence Engineering
skills.description: Persists and restores context state across sessions: what survives session close, in which tier, and how restoration reconstructs a working context faithfully.

skills.title: Context Boundary Engineering
skills.description: Engineers the boundaries between contexts: isolation between agents, scopes, and tenants; declared crossings only; leakage as a first-class failure.

skills.title: Memory Context Compress — Memory Concept Extraction & Context Window Compression
skills.description: Compiles a session transcript or account memory surface into a normalized, deduplicated memory checkpoint and a token-budgeted resume packet, so a fresh context window continues the work without replaying raw history.

skills.title: Repo Decomposition Tree
skills.description: Generates the full labeled decomposition of the OKF repo - every .md/.py/.json across all concept/skill/agent/asset levels, labeled L0-L5.

skills.title: Anchor Field Engineering
skills.description: Defines and binds the field space an anchor set lives in: node-property binding, same-sync-same-scale invariants, named field registration under data/anchors/ - trilateration works in any conforming field.

skills.title: Procedural Memory Engineering
skills.description: Engineers the procedural tier - the skill bundles as memory: creation = memorization, revision = consolidation, deprecation = forgetting, git history = lineage.

skills.title: Knowledge Graph Federation
skills.description: Owns OKF-to-external-KG interoperability: node/edge/property mapping contracts, sync direction, and the MCP host/client bridge pattern with Claude as host holding 1:N connections.

skills.title: Agentic Deep Search
skills.description: Superactivation deep search - the original $Maxey0: parallel multi-corpus retrieval lanes, per-SCW overlays, superimpose validation, multi-hop refinement, fused ranked evidence view.

skills.title: Orbital Selection
skills.description: Hierarchical routing across the concept/skill/agent orbital planes - each an anchor field touched in one superposed pass per level, with cross-plane coherence arbitration, beam-descent and lexical fallbacks, all bounded by the RECUR loop contract.

skills.title: SCW Partition Isolation
skills.description: The two architectures that partition a loop's context: in-window (typed regions, tool-layer refusal) and cross-window (one model call per agent, isolation by construction).

skills.title: Loop Composition Battery
skills.description: The live multi-agent battery and the loop-dataset build pipeline that hardens the 74 Maxey0-native loops into real SCW harnesses.
